name: Kebab Smash Taco
steps: To a bowl, add the lamb ground beef, chopped red onion, minced garlic, chopped corianter, and chopped jalapeno. Mix well and season with paprika, cumin, turmeric, salt and pepper. Mix together until everything is evenly combined.
Take a ball of the mixture, add it to a tortilla and smash it down with a spatula until it covers the entire surface. Repeat this process for the rest of the mixture.
Add the smashed kebabs to a hot pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
To make the sauce, mix together greek yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, garlic, salt, black pepper, chopped parsley and water for consistency in a small bowl.
Slice the tomato, red onion and cucumber into thin slices. Add it to the smashed kebab and top it with the sauce.
Fold the tortilla into a taco shape and serve.
